D.t: Debbie Dingell leads by 43.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 163,086 votes; a one point swing is about 1,870 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +35.7 and D +50.7. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
